//include: MUST list the same packages as typedoc.json's `entryPoints`. TypeDoc warns (not errors) when an entry point is absent here, so the two drift silently and the missing package's docs come out thin — that is how @azx/ribo-transcriber-pdfjs shipped with an entry point and no include. @azx/ribo-ui-react is deliberately absent from BOTH: it contains .tsx, and this config extends browser-library.json, which sets no `jsx`. Adding it needs react-library.json, which would pull JSX settings into every other package's docs pass.
